inclusions.text: Private cabin on a shared vessel
inclusions.source: Your party travels with its own Egyptologist; aboard you have a private cabin on a shared vessel.
Your party travels with its own Egyptologist; aboard you have a private cabin on a shared vessel.

inclusions.text: Four days, three nights on a comfortable lake cruise ship
inclusions.source: The vessel is a comfortable lake cruise ship: four days, three nights, days structured around landings at temple sites, afternoons and evenings spent sailing between them.

inclusions.text: Met at Abu Simbel Airport and transferred to the ship
inclusions.source: You are met at Abu Simbel Airport and transferred to the ship.

inclusions.text: Transfer to Aswan International Airport or onward
inclusions.source: After Kalabsha, you return to the ship for a final breakfast, then disembark and transfer to Aswan International Airport or onward.

itinerary.title: Abu Simbel: the southern beginning
itinerary.source: After the temples you return to the ship; dinner is taken as the vessel begins its northward journey.

itinerary.title: Qasr Ibrim and Amada
itinerary.source: The ship sails overnight toward Wadi es-Sebua.

itinerary.title: Wadi es-Sebua, Dakka and Maharraqa
itinerary.source: The afternoon is spent on board as the ship makes for Aswan.

itinerary.title: Kalabsha and the approach to Aswan
itinerary.source: After Kalabsha, you return to the ship for a final breakfast, then disembark and transfer to Aswan International Airport or onward.
